changes: Widgets now support Subtasks, Habit Categories and Measurable Habits
Task and Habit widgets use the same connected lists and spacing as the app
Completing a task from a widget completes its subtasks and clears their reminders
Added progress for Measurable Habits in the Habits widget
Fixed widgets logging Measurable Habits with the wrong value
Added Habit Categories, create categories and assign habits to them
Habits list now has "Today" and "All" filters based on the days a habit is scheduled
Overall Analytics can now be grouped by category
Added new Target Analytic for Measurable Habits
Added Subtasks. Add them by long pressing on a task
Fixed UI bug where add button covers reorder handle in tasks list #307
Fixed App crashing in private spaces #305
Fixed categories sheet disappearing after enabling dark mode #304
Increased habit title and description length limits
